mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flow_dispatch d WHERE (d.is_sample = 1 OR d.dept_id = #{deptId}) ) AS taskCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flow_dispatch d WHERE d.status = '启用' AND (d.is_sample = 1 OR d.dept_id = #{deptId}) ) AS activeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flow_dispatch d WHERE d.status = '停用' AND (d.is_sample = 1 OR d.dept_id = #{deptId}) ) AS stoppedCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flow_dispatch d WHERE d.is_sample = 1 ) AS sampleCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flow_task_dispatch td LEFT JOIN flow_dispatch d ON d.id = td.task_id WHERE (d.is_sample = 1 OR d.dept_id = #{deptId}) ) AS periodCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flow_task_member m LEFT JOIN flow_dispatch d ON d.id = m.task_id WHERE (d.is_sample = 1 OR d.dept_id = #{deptId}) ) AS memberCount

SELECT m.user_id AS yyytId, u.user_name AS userName, m.task_name AS taskName, NULL AS empNo, u.dept_name AS deptName, u.phone AS phone, m.create_time AS createTime FROM flow_task_member m LEFT JOIN aut_user u ON u.yyyt_id = m.user_id WHERE m.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY m.id ASC
